title: VPS and Dedicated Servers Term Price Schedule
content:
Harborline sells every server in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range on a 1-month, 12-month or 24-month term. Each tier has one price per month for each term length, and a one-time setup fee. All amounts are in US dollars.

## Schedule of term prices

| Tier | Price per month, 1-month term | Price per month, 12-month term | Price per month, 24-month term | One-time setup fee | Shortest term on which the setup fee is waived |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | 11.99 | 9.59 | 8.39 | 0.00 | 12 months |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | 23.99 | 19.19 | 16.79 | 0.00 | 12 months |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | 47.99 | 38.39 | 33.59 | 0.00 | 12 months |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | 95.99 | 76.79 | 67.19 | 0.00 | 12 months |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | 169.00 | 152.10 | 143.65 | 99.00 | 12 months |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | 289.00 | 260.10 | 245.65 | 99.00 | 12 months |

The setup fee is described in the tariff as a one-time setup fee, waived on 12 and 24-month terms. On every tier the shortest term on which it is waived is 12 months, so it is due only on a 1-month term; on the four Harborline VPS tiers the fee is 0.00 in any case.

## Account discount and rounding

| Tier | Account tier's server discount applies to term prices | Rounding of every computed server amount |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | Yes | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | Yes | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | Yes | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | Yes | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | Yes | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | Yes | Half up to the cent |

The server discount percentage itself belongs to the customer's Harborline account tier; this schedule records only that it applies to term prices on every server tier.

## Points of reading

- **Which price column applies?** The column matching the length of the term: the 1-month column for a 1-month term, the 12-month column for a 12-month term, the 24-month column for a 24-month term.
- **Is a 24-month term ever charged the setup fee?** No. A 24-month term is longer than the 12-month minimum on which the fee is waived, on every tier.
- **Does rounding apply only to the term price?** No. Half-up rounding to the cent is the rounding of every computed server amount on every tier.
